description: Legal Metrology compliance rules applicable to medical devices.

rules.title: Medical Devices Rules 2017 govern declarations on medical device packages
rules.requirement: For packages containing medical devices, declarations must be made in accordance with the Medical Devices Rules, 2017, rather than the general declaration provisions of the LM(PC) Rules, 2011.
rules.applies_when: Applies to packages containing medical devices.

source.document: 267107_1761404707.pdf — G.S.R. 778(E), dated 23 October 2025 (LM(PC) Amendment Rules, 2025 - Medical Devices)

rules.source_text: Provided that for packages containing medical devices, the provisions of the Medical Devices Rules, 2017, shall apply to make declarations;

rules.title: Medical Devices Rules 2017 govern numeral/letter height on medical device packages
rules.requirement: For packages containing medical devices, the height of any numeral and letter used to make declarations is governed by the Medical Devices Rules, 2017, instead of the LM(PC) Rules Table-I sizing requirement.
rules.applies_when: Applies to packages containing medical devices.

source.document: 267107_1761404707.pdf — G.S.R. 778(E), dated 23 October 2025 (LM(PC) Amendment Rules, 2025 - Medical Devices)

rules.source_text: Provided that for packages containing medical devices, the provisions of the Medical Devices Rules, 2017, shall apply for the height of any numeral and letter to make declarations.

rules.title: Medical Devices Rules 2017 govern numeral/letter width on medical device packages
rules.requirement: For packages containing medical devices, the width of any numeral and letter used to make declarations is governed by the Medical Devices Rules, 2017, instead of the LM(PC) Rules width-ratio requirement.
rules.applies_when: Applies to packages containing medical devices.

source.document: 267107_1761404707.pdf — G.S.R. 778(E), dated 23 October 2025 (LM(PC) Amendment Rules, 2025 - Medical Devices)

rules.source_text: Provided that for packages containing medical devices, the provisions of the Medical Devices Rules, 2017, shall apply for the width of any numeral and letter to make declarations.

rules.title: No rule 33 relaxation where Medical Devices Rules 2017 apply
rules.requirement: Where the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 are applicable to a package, the relaxation mechanism otherwise available under rule 33 of the LM(PC) Rules does not apply to that package.
rules.applies_when: Applies to packages containing medical devices governed by the Medical Devices Rules, 2017.

source.document: 267107_1761404707.pdf — G.S.R. 778(E), dated 23 October 2025 (LM(PC) Amendment Rules, 2025 - Medical Devices)

rules.source_text: In case where the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 are applicable, the relaxation given under this rule shall not apply.
